title: Women's Studies, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Built from the real 2022-2023 archived bulletin (raw HTML fetched and cross-checked against the page's own printed semester/Fall/Spring credit subtotals, which sum exactly to the page's own 'Total Credits 123' -- WebFetch was not trusted alone per this session's own hallucination-risk warning). Real, confirmed differences from the 2026 file: (1) the department was still named 'Women's Studies' this year (not yet 'Women's, Gender, and Sexuality Studies' -- that rename happened in the 2024-2025 bulletin edition), so 'title' and course descriptions use the 2022 name; (2) the prescribed major course was 'WMNST 301' (no N suffix) -- confirmed via the archived WMNST department course-description page that WMNST 301 and WMNST 301N were two distinct, separately-listed real course codes that year, so this is a genuine historical course-list difference, not a typo needing normalization (WMNST 301N is not used until 2024); (3) the Bachelor of Arts 'Other Cultures' requirement (Semester 7) was still called 'Other Cultures' that year, not yet renamed 'World Cultures' (renamed by 2024); (4) the program's own 'Additional Courses' pool for the intro WMNST requirement listed only 3 real options that year -- WMNST 83N, WMNST 100, WMNST 106N -- confirmed via both the Program Requirements text and the archived WMNST dept catalog; WMNST 105N, while it did already exist as a real course code in the 2022 catalog, was not yet part of this specific pool (it was only added to the bulletin's own pool text starting the 2024-2025 edition) -- so Semester 1 here intentionally has only 3 options, unlike the 2026 file's 4. Confirmed IDENTICAL to 2026 (same real requirement, same normalization applied): the Suggested Academic Plan's own printed course text reads 'WMNST 100, 106N, or WMNST 83S' -- WMNST 83S could not be confirmed to exist in the 2022 dept catalog (only WMNST 83N exists), so normalized to WMNST 83N, exactly matching the 2026 file's own documented normalization of the identical typo. No LA 83 / LA 283 Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar requirement existed yet in this plan (that was added starting the 2025-2026 edition) -- Total Credits is a real, lower 123 across all 8 semesters (16,16,16,15,15,15,15,15) with no seminar-credit shortfall gap, unlike the 2026 file's own documented 4cr Semester-1 gap (this file's Semester 1/2 fully account for World Language Level 1 AND Level 2, matching the page's own printed 16/16 Fall/Spring subtotals exactly -- verified against the raw HTML table row-by-row, not just the summarized text). Entrance to Major (2.00 GPA + third-semester classification), the WMNST400N/401 pool, the WMNST494/495/496 pool, WMNST 492W, ENGL 202A-D pool, and the CAS 100A/B/C normalization are all confirmed identical to 2026. Real bulletin page also has its own 'At which campus can I study this program?' section this year reading 'Begin Campus: Any Penn State Campus / End Campus: University Park' -- i.e. this major has never had a genuine Erie/Brandywine completion campus in any of the 5 catalog years checked (see WMNSTBA-2026.json for the full campus-check citation); not re-noted here since campus scoping is out of scope for a historical-year file. No department handbook beyond the bulletin could be found for this year either, matching 2026.
